subject: Insurance
title: The Australian Black Summer
description: A quick, practical guide to The Australian Black Summer.

hook.text: Australia's 2019-2020 Black Summer burned 46 million acres and destroyed 3,000 homes. Insurance claims hit $1.6 billion.

buildup.text: Climate change made the fires unprecedented.

discovery.text: Many homeowners discovered they were underinsured.

twist.text: Insurers are now withdrawing from fire-prone areas entirely.

climax.text: Black Summer showed that climate change is making wildfires uninsurable. When risk exceeds models, insurance retreats.

quiz.question: What insurance problem did Australia's Black Summer reveal?
